svg.title: 40-stress
svg.text: The whole run: 8.0 s, 320 presented frames on a 60 Hz display, measured against a 33.3 ms target.
More about this run in the notes at the end of the card.
16.7 ms per refresh, target 1 refresh (60 fps)

text.tspan: The target is not whole refreshes

svg.text: 320 frame(s) aim at a target frame time of 25 ms, which is not a whole number of this display's 16.67 ms refreshes.
A frame stays on screen for whole refreshes: those frames are judged against the target in whole refreshes, so holding such a target reads as off.

text.tspan: hatched grey: the target is not whole refreshes

svg.text: ANIMATION ERROR PER FRAME: + SHOWN TOO SOON, − SHOWN TOO LATE
DISPLAY TIME STEP: HOW LONG EACH FRAME STAYED ON SCREEN
FRAMETIME AND CPU BUSY: THE APPLICATION SIDE, FROM THE MARKERS
━ frametime: CPU start to the next ■ CPU busy: until presented ┅ target
SHARE OF LATE FRAMES IN THE LAST 2 S (WHOLE RUN 0.0 %)
REFRESH STRIP: ONE CELL PER REFRESH, A NEW SHADE PER FRAME
EVENTS: WHAT THE FRAMES DID, WHAT THE CAPTURE MISSED
Resolution 16.7 ms (one capture period); error threshold 1 ms.
